spatial_flow_description: Use a balanced three-column layout. The left column contains two separate memory boxes: upper “参数记忆” with “固定适配器库” and “能力与版本”, lower “轨迹记忆” with “容量内回放” and “工具规则复核”. Each feeds a larger central “持续更新” box containing three ruled rows “当前任务学习”, “历史回放”, “低秩干扰约束”. A small box “加权训练池” sits above and feeds the same central update box. A solid arrow from the update stage reaches a dashed-border right box “冻结策略”, containing “交给独立校准”. Beneath the update box place “容量管理” with “合并｜替换｜冻结”. Connect the central update downward into capacity management, then use two dashed feedback paths returning from capacity management to the two memory boxes. Keep these return paths outside the forward-flow corridor. Across the bottom draw a narrow evaluation band headed “保持评价”, containing “历史测试仅评价｜容量与成本匹配”. That band is explanatory and must not feed either memory box.
caption_note: 路线三：在附加参数和轨迹字节容量限制下联合管理参数记忆与经验回放。合并选择依据历史开发集，历史测试集仅报告能力保持结果。
No measurements or pre-experiment results are rendered.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: White canvas and WHITE box fills with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
At most three blue chromatic colors plus neutrals.
Native structural rectangles, dividers and connectors only; every main block has a geometric anchor.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Dashed borders for frozen modules; dashed arrows for feedback or unverified mechanism.
No overall title, invented formulas, dimensions or performance numbers.
Readable simplified Chinese, no cropping or overlapping labels.
